career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Candidates recruited through the Mizoram Subordinate Services Selection Board (MSSSB) Combined Group 'C' Examination are appointed to clerical and executive subordinate posts including Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Assistant Sub-Inspector, and Junior Field Assistants in Mizoram Services (ROP) Rules 2018 Pay Matrix Level 4 (₹25,500 – ₹56,800 / ₹81,100). Ministerial staff advance through departmental promotion committees to Upper Division Clerk (UDC, Level 6, ₹35,400 – ₹78,800), Assistant / Head Assistant (Level 7, ₹39,100 – ₹86,800), Superintendent (Level 8, ₹44,900 – ₹99,800), and Gazetted Under Secretary (Level 10, ₹56,100 – ₹1,24,500) within the Mizoram Secretariat and Subordinate Directorates.

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹14,790 per month on entry basic of ₹25,500 as of 01.07.2025) as notified by Finance Department, Government of Mizoram.
HRA at 8% of Basic Pay (₹2,040 per month) for Aizawl and district headquarters, or government staff quarters accommodation.
Special compensatory allowance for postings in hilly and remote administrative blocks of Mizoram.
Fixed medical allowance of ₹1,000 per month plus Mizoram State Health Care Scheme / Medical Attendance reimbursement.
New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% Government co-contribution and State Group Insurance Scheme.
